title: Reverse a string
prompt: Print the word swift reversed (tfiws).
hint: Strings can be reversed with reversed(); wrap the result in String(...).
starter:
let word = "swift"
// Print the word reversed
solution:
let word = "swift"
print(String(word.reversed()))

title: Palindrome check
prompt: Complete isPalindrome so it ignores case, then print one line per word in the form word: true or word: false.
hint: Lowercase the string, then compare it with its reversed version.
expected:
level: true
swift: false
Racecar: true

title: Remove duplicates
prompt: Remove the duplicates from the array and print the remaining numbers sorted ascending, as an array.
hint: Convert to a Set, then call sorted().
starter:
let numbers = [4, 2, 4, 1, 2, 3, 1]
// Print the unique numbers sorted ascending
solution:
let numbers = [4, 2, 4, 1, 2, 3, 1]
print(Array(Set(numbers)).sorted())

title: Word counter
prompt: Count how often each word appears in the sentence and print one line per word as word: count, in alphabetical order.
hint: Build a [String: Int] with split(separator:), then iterate over keys.sorted().

title: Switch with ranges and where
prompt: For each number print negative, zero, small (1-9), even large or odd large (10 or more) using one switch with ranges and a where clause.
hint: Use cases like case 1...9 and case let n where n % 2 == 0.
expected:
negative
zero
small
even large
odd large

prompt: Search a, b in 1...9 for the first pair with a + b == 10 and a * b == 21, print Found a and b like Found 3 and 7, and stop both loops.
hint: Name the outer loop (outer: for ...) and use break outer.

title: Star triangle
prompt: Using nested loops print a right triangle of stars with 4 rows (1 star in the first row, 4 in the last).
hint: Use String(repeating: "*", count: row) or an inner loop.

title: Recursion: factorial and Fibonacci
prompt: Implement factorial and fib recursively and print 5! = 120 and fib(10) = 55 in exactly that format.
hint: Base cases: factorial(0) = 1; fib(0) = 0 and fib(1) = 1.

title: inout and variadic parameters
prompt: Write addAll(_ numbers: Int..., to total: inout Int) that adds every number to total. Start with total = 10, call addAll(1, 2, 3, to: &total) and print total.
hint: A variadic parameter is an array inside the function; inout needs & at the call site.

title: Closure that captures a counter
prompt: Write makeCounter() returning a closure that increments a captured variable and returns it. Call one counter three times and a second counter once; print each result on its own line.
hint: The returned closure keeps its own copy of the captured var.

title: Struct with computed property
prompt: Complete the Rectangle struct with a computed property area and a mutating method scale(by:) that multiplies both sides. Scale a 2x3 rectangle by 2 and print Area: 24.
hint: Computed properties use var name: Type { ... }; mutating methods can change self.

title: Inheritance and override
prompt: Make Dog inherit from Animal and override sound() to return Woof. Print the sounds of an Animal and a Dog as Animal: ... and Dog: ... on two lines.
hint: Mark the subclass method with override and call it on instances.

title: Protocol default implementation
prompt: Give the Greeter protocol a default greet() in an extension that returns Hello, NAME!. Make Person use the default and Robot override it with BEEP NAME. Print both greetings.
hint: Declare greet() in the protocol and implement it in extension Greeter; types can still provide their own.

title: Generic Stack
prompt: Build a generic Stack<T> struct with push, pop (returns an optional) and a peek property. Push 1, 2, 3, then print the peek, the popped value and the count.
hint: Store items in a private array; pop with popLast().

title: Enum with raw values
prompt: Make Level an Int-backed enum conforming to CaseIterable (low = 1, mid, high). Print each case as name=rawValue, one per line.
hint: Use enum Level: Int, CaseIterable and loop over Level.allCases.

title: Throwing functions
prompt: Complete divide(_:_:) so it throws DivError.byZero when b is 0. Print 5 for 10 / 2 and, using do/catch, print Cannot divide by zero for 1 / 0.
hint: Mark the function throws and call it with try inside do { } catch { }.

title: Property wrapper
prompt: Complete the Clamped property wrapper so the stored value stays between 0 and 100. Set health to 150 and print it, then set it to -20 and print it.
hint: Use min(max(value, 0), 100) in the setter, and mark with @propertyWrapper.

title: Property observers
prompt: Add a didSet observer to score that prints Score changed from OLD to NEW. Then set score to 5 and to 12.
hint: Inside didSet, oldValue is available; use the current score for the new value.
expected:
Score changed from 0 to 5
Score changed from 5 to 12

title: Codable to JSON
prompt: Encode the Person value to JSON using .sortedKeys, print the string, then decode it back and print the decoded name.
hint: Set encoder.outputFormatting = .sortedKeys and decode with JSONDecoder.

title: async/await
prompt: Complete the async function square and use await at top level to print the sum of square(3) and square(4).
hint: Mark the function async and call it with await.
